Name: TROLLEY_COMPARTMENTS
Description: Compartments on one trolley.

Name: COMPARTMENT_CAP
Description: Most garments one compartment holds.

Name: MAX_BATCHES_PER_TROLLEY
Description: Most fabric batches one trolley may carry (Change 2); never 3.

Name: TOPUP_BATCH_CAP_FROM_SCENARIO
Description: true: a waiting trolley is topped up only up to the scenario's own batch limit, so 1 batch never mixes (Q1 fixed).

Name: MAX_TROLLEYS_PER_COMBINE
Description: Most trolleys one combine may need.

Name: TROLLEY_BAYS
Description: Most part-filled trolleys waiting at once (13 workstations x 4 positions).

Name: FLEET_SIZE
Description: Trolleys owned.

Name: CYCLE_DAYS_ALLOWED
Description: Round-trip allowance (1 + 3 + 1 days).

Name: CYCLE_DAYS_ESTIMATED
Description: Round trip used for the fleet figures. Never timed.

Name: WIP_HOLD_MINUTES
Description: How long a part-filled trolley waits in CCT WIP (Change 3, S3).

Name: WIP_HOLD_ANY_WORKSTATION
Description: true: a waiting trolley may be recalled to any workstation.

Name: WIP_HOLD_MATCH_ON
Description: What a waiting trolley must share with a new table to be topped up.

Name: FILM_SIZE_BY_GARMENT_SIZE
Description: Film width each garment size is cut on; stands in for the real Net_Rate.

Name: UNIVERSAL_SIZES
Description: Sizes in the film map. A table with any other size loads no compartments.

Name: TASK_STATUS_COLORS
Description: Colours of the eight task-readiness statuses (display only).

Description: Statuses that can never appear in the model, and why.

Name: RELAX_HOURS
Description: Time fabric must relax before it is spread.

Name: CUT_GROUPS_BY_CUTTER_COUNT
Description: Which spreaders each cutter serves, at 5 (today) to 8 cutters. 6 to 8 are engine-only what-ifs.

Name: CUTTER_COUNT
Description: Cutting machines today.

Name: SIM_CUTTER_COUNTS
Description: Cutter counts the engine and measurement scripts can run.

Name: CUT_GROUPS
Description: Today's cut groups.

Description: Spreaders that may call a second cutter.

Name: NIGHT_SHIFT_SPREADERS
Description: Spreaders that also work the night shift.

Name: NIGHT_SHIFT_CUTTERS
Description: Cutters that also work the night shift.

Name: SHIFT_START_MINUTE
Description: Start of the day shift (07:15). The model clock is minutes after it.

Name: DAY_SHIFT
Description: Day shift window (07:15–20:00).

Name: NIGHT_SHIFT
Description: Night shift window (18:00–05:00).

Name: BREAKS_STOP_MACHINES
Description: true: machines stop during breaks. Unconfirmed.

Name: SPREADING_TABLE_LENGTH_M
Description: Spreading table length, the same on all 13 spreaders.

Description: Unit conversion; marker lengths are in yards.

Description: Table length in yards (EQ10).

Description: Table lengths the engine can run (24 and 27 m are hypothetical); no page control.

Name: LAY_NEEDS_FULL_LENGTH
Description: true: a lay starts only when its whole length is free.

Name: MACHINE_FILL_TARGET
Description: Queued spreading kept under this share of a spreader's staffed time (S1–S3 planner).

Name: SPREAD_MIN_PER_LAYER_PER_YARD
Description: Spreading rate (0.80 / 8.5).

Name: CUT_MIN_PER_LAYER_PER_YARD
Description: Cutting rate (0.40 / 8.5).

Name: REQUIRED_PIECES_PER_DAY
Description: Pieces Central Cutting must cut a day.

Name: ORDER_TYPE_PRIORITY
Description: Today's Job Sequence priority by order type; the live table was not supplied.

Name: ORDER_TYPE_PRIORITY_DEFAULT
Description: Rank of any other or empty order type.

Name: LIVE_FLOOR

Name: REPLAN_MINUTES
Description: The Job Sequence re-plans this often, around the clock.

Name: PLAN_HORIZON_HOURS
Description: Each re-plan fills the spreaders' staffed time this far ahead.

Name: C_SETUP_MINUTES_MIN_TENTHS
Description: Shortest Type C setup.

Description: Longest Type C setup.

Name: C_SETUP_HASH_OFFSET

Description: FNV-1a 32-bit prime.
